about: Reference specifications (reference / Founders boards) like GPU-Z shows them. Pixel rate = ROPs x boost, texture rate = TMUs x boost, FP32 = shaders x flopsPerClock x boost (RDNA 3/4 count dual-issue, as AMD and TechPowerUp do), bandwidth = bus width / 8 x Gbps. Partner cards with factory overclocks run a little higher. Source: TechPowerUp GPU Database and the makers' spec pages. pci = PCI device IDs (DEV) used only when the Windows name matches no entry (renamed or OEM cards); several cards can share one ID.
